title: Exact Polynomial Structural FLINT
objective: Add generated declared-FLINT production adapters and lazy kernels for composition, reversal, shifts, truncation, integration where valid, resultant, and discriminant over exact polynomial resources and word-sized prime fields, without public Polynomial wiring

handoff.summary: Generated 22 declared FLINT operations plus 24 source-transparent typed-Python wrappers for integer/rational resource and word-prime structural polynomial calculus. Exact outputs are callee-owned resources; packed prime outputs commit transactionally. Focused tests cover Sage fixtures, zero/constant resultants and discriminants, positive-characteristic derivative degree loss, canonical reverse/truncate normalization, native/dynamic parity, and 200-round ASan/UBSan lifecycle fuzzing. Warm direct-adapter medians include 0.58 ms integer composition, 0.42 ms integer resultant, 0.20 ms rational integration, 0.95 ms prime composition, and 0.010 ms prime resultant on the lane host.
risks: Exact FLINT resources remain wasm-disabled in the current declaration system; packed word-prime adapters are wasm-enabled.

The packed nmod integral is deliberately restricted to source length below the characteristic. Longer inputs with zero exceptional coefficients can be semantically integrable and must route to the portable same-source implementation; focused tests pin this as a transactional capability rejection.

Full pnpm test:native reached the pre-existing volatile dense GF(p) multiply_300 performance gate and failed at 20.91 normalized ms versus a 15 ms budget; an immediate isolated rerun reproduced host variability and no structural-polynomial failure. All preceding native package, compiler, migration, and resource tests passed.
next_steps: Rebase onto the corrected structural_calculus implementation and wire public Polynomial dispatch separately, preserving its negative-truncate and characteristic-hole semantics.
Normalize fixed-width packed prime outputs at the public Polynomial constructor boundary.
Exercise the wasm-enabled nmod declarations in the browser build and add exact-resource wasm lowering when the generic generated resource backend lands.
